chunks: Eat of the good things We have given you for food, and do not exceed the bounds (of law) in this, or My wrath will surely fall upon you; and he who incurs My wrath will fall into the abyss.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'do not exceed the bounds' in Surah Taa-Haa regarding consumption of provisions?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Taa-Ha is often linked to the concept of 'ghuluw' (exaggeration or transgression) not only in material consumption but also in religious practice, warning against excess that leads to spiritual deviation. It underscores the balance between enjoying God's blessings and maintaining gratitude, serving as a practical guide for ethical living in accordance with the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings on moderation.
